start.title: [TODO:tr] Morning in Nazareth
start.text:
[TODO:tr] Dawn settles over your small home.
You begin the quiet work of the day.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Your heart was made for stillness.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Return to Stillness
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The village holds no answer for you.
Go home and quiet your heart.

wander_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] A Pull Within
wander_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Even among the crowd, your heart feels called.
Return to your room.

gabriel.title: [TODO:tr] A Light at the Door
gabriel.text:
[TODO:tr] A radiant figure stands before you.
"Hail, favored one. The Lord is with you."

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Do Not Be Afraid
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] His voice is gentle as morning.
"Do not be afraid, Mary."

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Lay Down Your Pride
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Heaven owes you nothing, yet offers everything.
Receive in humility.

ponder.title: [TODO:tr] What Greeting Is This?
ponder.text:
[TODO:tr] His words trouble your young heart.
What could such favor mean?

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Heaven is not so easily turned.

sendaway_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] He Remains
sendaway_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The angel does not move.
His message is not yours to refuse.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You fold your hands and wait.

announce.title: [TODO:tr] You Will Bear a Son
announce.text:
[TODO:tr] "You will conceive and bear a son.
Call his name Jesus. He will be great."

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] This gift is not for sale.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Listen Once More
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] His eyes are gentle, not forceful.
Let your honest heart speak.

wealth_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Treasures Above
wealth_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] No coin can hold this promise.
Ask what truly burdens you.

question.title: [TODO:tr] How Can This Be?
question.text:
[TODO:tr] "The Holy Spirit will come upon you.
Nothing is impossible with God."

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Say: let it be unto me

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Open Your Heart
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Silence cannot carry this child.
Give your full answer now.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Say: let it be unto me

accept.title: [TODO:tr] Let It Be
accept.text:
[TODO:tr] "Behold, I am the servant of the Lord.
Let it be unto me as you have said."
